mapper.select: SELECT p.perfume_id, p.image_route, p.brand, p.perfume_name, p.price, CASE WHEN pn.note_level = 'TOP' THEN n.note_name END as top_note, CASE WHEN pn.note_level = 'MIDDLE' THEN n.note_name END as mid_note, CASE WHEN pn.note_level = 'BASE' THEN n.note_name END as base_note, CASE WHEN pn.note_level = 'SINGLE' THEN n.note_name END as single_note FROM public.perfume p LEFT JOIN public.perfume_note pn ON p.perfume_id = pn.perfume_id LEFT JOIN public.note n ON pn.note_id = n.note_id WHERE p.perfume_id = #{perfumeId}
SELECT a.accord_name FROM public.perfume_accord pa JOIN public.accord a ON pa.accord_id = a.accord_id WHERE pa.perfume_id = #{perfumeId} ORDER BY pa.perfume_accord_id ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN m.is_delete = true THEN '(탈퇴한 회원)' ELSE m.nickname END as nickname, r.detail content, r.rating, TO_CHAR(r.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as createAt FROM public.review r JOIN public.member m ON r.member_id = m.member_Id WHERE r.perfume_id = #{perfumeId} AND r.is_delete = false ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.perfume p WHERE p.is_delete = false
AND (p.perfume_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR p.brand ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
